$comment: Baseline VS Code user-scope settings for a heir workspace that installs alex-act-core.
The `settings` object is a stable, ACT-critical subset. Heirs can extend it by editing this
file inside the plugin install directory, or by copying it into their own workspace and
(1) Update infrastructure - keeps heirs current with Copilot rollouts.
(2) Chat agent core (REQUIRED) - ACT depends on these to load skills / instructions and run act-pass.
(3) Copilot chat features (REQUIRED) - memory tiers, codesearch, deferred tool loading, and Agent Skills.
The experimental generic skill tool stays disabled while microsoft/vscode#314772 prevents it from
resolving plugin-contributed skills. This does not disable chat.useAgentSkills or file-based loading.
(5) UX cohesion - small chat surface conveniences, not policy-critical.
(6) Experimental opt-outs (REQUIRED) - ACT prefers explicit context over implicit and fresh symbol info over stable cache.
(7) Safety locks (REQUIRED) - defensive false locks against dangerous Claude Agent permission modes.
Format note: $comment is an array of strings for source readability. Per JSON Schema spec the
field is informational only; no validator enforces type. The prompts only read the settings object.
